structural_reasons: STRUCTURAL GAP: a participant-directed 404(c) menu assumes daily pricing and daily participant liquidity, whereas this wrapper deals daily but only within a 5% cap per quarter on NAV. Direct DIA use requires a bridging structure: CIT sleeve, managed account, or TDF sleeve (cell 3.5).
scenario_reasons: Capacity: 5% per quarter on NAV: at most 20% of the position per year. This is a FUND-level cap shared by every holder, so the plan's position is served only while offers are not oversubscribed.

Filed outflow proxy (Schedule H, plan year 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31): 11.5% of the position per year vs 20% annual wrapper capacity, the plan's total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets, applied to the position. Adequate headroom at the filed rate if offers are not prorated.

Slider assumption (illustrative): 7.2% of the position per year vs 20% annual wrapper capacity, from tail turnover 20%/yr on the 14.9% of accounts that are separated and active turnover 5%/yr on the rest. Shown beside the filed rate, not blended with it. Within 60% of wrapper capacity at these sliders.

Scenario verdict (ILLUSTRATIVE, this plan): conditional. No rung fired: the filed outflow proxy 11.5% and the stressed demand 16.6% of the position per year both stay within the annual wrapper capacity 20% (binding cap 5% per quarter on NAV (3.1), daily repurchase requests (3.1), program active as of 2025-12-31 (3.1), no proration identified (3.3)). Per quarter: filed 2.9% and stressed 4.2% of the position against the 5% cap. Proration assumption: an oversubscribed offer is filled pro rata and the unfilled remainder waits for the next window.

Schedule H benefit-payment line 2e is not yet in the plan record. The filed outflow proxy (total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets) stands in for it as the base demand, and the turnover sliders are the stress around it.

filed_outflow.label: filed outflow proxy
filed_outflow.formula: (total expenses minus total administrative expenses) / net assets at the beginning of the plan year * 100
filed_outflow.source: Schedule H totals of the plan's Form 5500 for plan year 2024-01-01 to 2024-12-31, from the plan record
filed_outflow.what: total expenses less administrative expenses over beginning net assets, an upper bound on benefit payments while Schedule H line 2e is not in the record

stressed_scenario.assumptions: the filed outflow proxy plus the increment the sliders add under stress (tail turnover x2, active turnover x1.5 over the slider assumption)
stressed_scenario.outcome: within wrapper capacity (16.6% vs 20%) IF offers are not prorated

null_reasons.net_assets_usd: aggregate NAV not yet carried into a typed cell. Verification-queue item

wrapper_facts.dealing_label: daily repurchase requests, 5% cap per quarter on NAV

fund_capacity.reason: the fund's net assets are not typed in the record (aggregate NAV not yet carried into a typed cell. Verification-queue item), so the plan's dollar demand cannot be set against the fund's dollar capacity and the allocation slider is not shown
